messages:
maria: @oncall Tenant 'acme-qa' opened SUP-7421 — intermittent 403 on KMS Decrypt starting after a key rotation this morning. Also seeing p95 decrypt latency jump from ~2s to ~12s and a billing usage spike. Any oncall eyes?

jon: can you paste the raw errors / request ids from proxy logs?

maria: logs from proxy-01: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:21Z ERROR decrypt failed keyId=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-09 status=403 error=AccessDenied requestId=abcd-1234-ef56
2026-03-15T09:12:22Z WARN decrypt latency=12.3s trace=trace-8742
2026-03-15T09:12:25Z INFO billing tokens_billed=+15% window=08:00-09:30
```

sara: those requestIds map to proxy-01 traces — we had a change in the proxy that started trimming headers >4096 bytes last week. If x-amz-enc-context is dropped, KMS will deny when key policy expects EncryptionContext.

keith: note: K-09 (arn:.../abcd-09) was rotated at 2026-03-15T08:05. Keys with key policy condition aws:EncryptionContext present will return AccessDenied if context missing. Quick repro (local):
```
# with encryption context -> succeeds
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --encryption-context '{"tenant":"acme-qa","req":"123"}' --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-09
# without -> AccessDenied / 403
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-09
```

kms-proxy-bot: [ALERT] decrypt-latency high on proxy-01 (p95=11.8s), error-rate decrypt=5.1% (since 08:05). Related traces: https://traces.internal/r/8742

support-bot: ticket SUP-7421 created by acme-qa. Customer impact: intermittent failures on production, partial feature outage, billing anomaly reported.

jon: can we see proxy config/version? Looks like a truncation guard was added in the header middleware during the last deploy (2026-03-15T07:58). Might be correlated.

sara: repro steps I used locally:
1) build a 5KB JSON for x-amz-enc-context
2) curl proxy /decrypt with that header -> proxy truncates to ~4KB
3) backend KMS sees no context -> returns 403
Example: 
```
curl -v -H "x-amz-enc-context: {\"tenant\":\"acme-qa\", \"meta\":\"<big payload>\"}" https://proxy.internal/decrypt
# response: 403 AccessDenied from KMS
```

keith: mitigation plan: 1) rollback proxy flag that enforces 4KB cap (short term) 2) add temporary KMS grant for acme-qa principal to allow Decrypt while we patch proxy (requires compliance sign-off for grant scope) 3) longer-term: change proxy to base64-encode enc context and preserve full payload.

maria: I'm rolling back the proxy change now and notifying customer. Assigning: @keith to open a scoped grant + KMS support case if needed; @jon to prepare a patch to stop trimming headers and add base64 encoding; @sara to create minimal repro artifact for QA. I'll update SUP-7421 when rollback completes.

jon: starting rollback deploy (reverting middleware commit) — ETA ~8m :hourglass:

keith: I'll prepare the grant docs and send to compliance for rapid approval. If compliance blocks, we'll prefer a short-lived grant with narrow principal and expiry.

sara: added small repro script to SUP-7421 comments so SRE can validate after rollback.

maria: thanks team — holding customer call at 09:45. Will post a follow-up with RCA and next steps. :thumbsup:
